contexts.text: Some Spirits who were as it were stationary over head, kept me awake... These stationary Spirits kept me in a middle state, nearer wakefulness than sleep, and thus harassed me... SE 2942.
It was permitted that they should have their stationary ones with me: without these they could not inflow so well.
A certain stationary one of those who were above me... was turned into filthy intestines.
